answer.reason: Aaron's life is told at length, so four chief deeds beyond the summary are given: the rod before Pharaoh, the golden calf, the atoning incense, and his death.

clauses.english: cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and it became a serpent
made a molten calf from the people's golden earrings
clauses.quote: after he had made it a molten calf

clauses.english: ran among the people with incense and stopped the plague
clauses.quote: he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people
Aaron died there in the top of the mount

doubts: Left out his consecration to the priesthood, the budding rod, and the penalty at Meribah, to keep to four chief events.
Left out verses that name Aaron only as part of 'sons of Aaron', 'house of Aaron' or 'Aaronites'.

answer.reason: Aaron's life is told at length, with several major events beyond the summary: speaking for Moses, the rod, the golden calf, consecration, the atoning censer, the budding rod, and death on Mount Hor.

clauses.english: spoke to Pharaoh for Moses and cast down his rod, which became a serpent
clauses.quote: Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

clauses.english: made the golden calf for the people at Sinai
clauses.quote: Up, make us gods, which shall go before us

clauses.english: was anointed and consecrated with his sons to the priest's office
clauses.quote: he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

clauses.english: ran with incense among the people and stopped the plague
clauses.quote: he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.

clauses.english: saw his rod bud and bear almonds, chosen among the twelve tribes' rods
clauses.quote: the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded

clauses.english: was stripped of his garments and died on Mount Hor
clauses.quote: Aaron died there in the top of the mount

doubts: Left out the penalty at Meribah (NUM 20:12) and the clause about speaking against Moses (NUM 12) to keep to the chief events.
Omitted verses naming 'Aaron' only as part of 'sons of Aaron' or 'house of Aaron'.
